newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK airport briefly closed after jet tire bursts.
newsitem.headline: HK airport briefly closed after jet tire bursts.

text.p: A burst tyre on a Virgin Atlantic Airways flight arriving from London forced a brief closure of the Hong Kong airport on Wednesday, airport authorities said.
Flight VS200, an Airbus A340, burst a tyre upon landing in Hong Kong, a civil aviation department official told Reuters.
An airline spokeswoman said the flight was carrying 248 passengers, including three babies, from Heathrow.

A fire services officer said some hydraulic liquid was found leaking from the undercarriage, and the runway was closed for about half an hour. There were no reports of injuries and passengers were being taken off the plane and sent to the terminal by bus, he said.
